metadata.source: Live-file-inventory-2026-11-20 (433 folder snapshots; requires current live folder re-list before final verification)
metadata.purpose: Read-only crosswalk for 139 historical files[].path entries in 66 first-batch creature Manifest JSON files
metadata.scope_statement: Unique file ID by current subject, four-form index, and asset role does not establish historical archive binary byte equivalence or asset/artistic approval; original historical path slots remain unmodified.
metadata_format_notes: The crosswalk locates exactly one current physical file per historical slot using explicit subject/form/asset role. It does not prove this exact byte sequence is the original archived delivery.
28 .blend objects have unusual Drive MIME types; each was downloaded and had an uncompressed BLENDER-v402 header despite its MIME. MIME metadata was not changed.

16 .blend objects (aqua_slime, fire_wisp, ice_snowman, thunder_drone; four forms each) are Zstandard-compressed containers that decompress without error to data starting BLENDER17-01v0502, not the usual 12-byte Blender header. Do not assume Blender can load these until independently validated; no claim of a valid Blender scene is made.
No binary was modified. No Blender, Colab GPU, or human QA approval was performed.
